quarterly_data.signal: VAST Data announced an Agent Sandbox Foundation Stack with NVIDIA, combining the VAST AI Operating System with NVIDIA NemoClaw and NVIDIA OpenShell to give each sandboxed agent an isolated workspace, persistent state, data services and a complete record of its actions.
